hypotheses.construction_plan: Define the diagonal template L(theta) = M(theta, theta). Obtain each member by replacing theta with the corresponding scalar argument: theta=1 gives M(1,1); theta=2 gives M(2,2).
required_assumptions: M is a binary applied function symbol
Substitution of scalar arguments into the template is well-defined
hypotheses.rationale: Both observed members apply the same binary function M to two identical scalar arguments, so the shared structure is the diagonal restriction of M; this is a one-parameter substitution family.
